closed_notes.conclusion: The six channel controls' +0x34 GBK strings are HOVER TOOLTIPS (text) only, never static captions. They are drawn by 0x00417370 (tooltip renderer), called unconditionally from the +0x25==1 hover branch of paint 0x00417640 at 0x41771B, at the cursor position with 0x96FFFF light-yellow background + 1px black frame via DrawTextA flags 0x25. Normal paint 0x417830 and frame blit 0x460240 are frame-surface only; the sole +0x34 read sites are 0x417373/0x417378 inside the tooltip renderer (ctor write 0x4175CD, subobject zero 0x417622). Click dispatch 0x4149A0 does not read +0x34; it injects separate command templates (0x47AD88-family) into the native EDIT box (SetWindowTextA 0x4762CC, HWND 0x8AA48C). Full VA evidence chain in chat-window-render-evidence.json closed_notes.

[0x8AB7C4] written only via IDirectDraw::CreateSurface out-param (0x45D53D/0x45D552, 0x45D602/0x45D617 in 0x45D380) - no static store exists.

Close route: close-button child (chat+0x6C, vtable 0x4763A8) hit-test vtable+0x10=0x4177F0 -> chat click dispatch 0x4149A0 returns 1 -> mouse stub 0x42C0B7 -> push 8; call dispatcher 0x42ADB0 (ROOT) -> jump-table 0x42B3E4[8]=0x42B180 -> hide (park edit, remove window 8 from activation list 0x42AC50, chat+0x30=0, ret 0) or show (place edit in chat rect, ShowWindow(edit,5), add window 8 via 0x42AC30->0x449870, chat+0x30=1, ret 1).
